paragraphs.text: translated by
1. SEND us a good and happy mind, send energy and mental power.
paragraphs.original: भद्रं नो अपि वातय मनो दक्षमुत क्रतुम् ।
paragraphs.translit: bhadraṃ no api vātaya mano dakṣamuta kratum |

paragraphs.text: Then-at your glad carouse-let men joy in thy love, Sweet juice! as kine in pasture. Thou art waxing great.
paragraphs.original: अधा ते सख्ये अन्धसो वि वो मदे रणन्गावो न यवसे विवक्षसे
paragraphs.translit: adhā te sakhye andhaso vi vo made raṇangāvo na yavase vivakṣase

paragraphs.text: 2. rn all thy forms, O Soma, rest thy powers that influence the heart.
paragraphs.original: हृदिस्पृशस्त आसते विश्वेषु सोम धामसु ।
paragraphs.translit: hṛdispṛśasta āsate viśveṣu soma dhāmasu |

paragraphs.text: So also these my longings-at your glad carouse-spread themselves seeking riches. Thou art waxing great.
paragraphs.original: अधा कामा इमे मम वि वो मदे वि तिष्ठन्ते वसूयवो विवक्षसे
paragraphs.translit: adhā kāmā ime mama vi vo made vi tiṣṭhante vasūyavo vivakṣase

paragraphs.text: 3. Even if, O Soma, I neglect thy laws through my simplicity,
paragraphs.original: उत व्रतानि सोम ते प्राहं मिनामि पाक्या ।
paragraphs.translit: uta vratāni soma te prāhaṃ mināmi pākyā |

paragraphs.text: Be gracious-at your glad carouse-as sire to son. Preserve us even from slaughter. Thou art waxing great.
paragraphs.original: अधा पितेव सूनवे वि वो मदे मृळा नो अभि चिद्वधाद्विवक्षसे
paragraphs.translit: adhā piteva sūnave vi vo made mṛḷā no abhi cidvadhādvivakṣase

paragraphs.text: 4. Our songs in concert go to thee as streams of water to the wells.
paragraphs.original: समु प्र यन्ति धीतयः सर्गासोऽवताँ इव ।
paragraphs.translit: samu pra yanti dhītayaḥ sargāso'vatām̐ iva |

paragraphs.text: Soma, that we may live, grant-at your glad carouse-full powers of mind, like beakers. Thou art waxing great.
paragraphs.original: क्रतुं नः सोम जीवसे वि वो मदे धारया चमसाँ इव विवक्षसे
paragraphs.translit: kratuṃ naḥ soma jīvase vi vo made dhārayā camasām̐ iva vivakṣase

paragraphs.text: 5. O Soma, through thy might who art skillful and strong, these longing men,
paragraphs.original: तव त्ये सोम शक्तिभिर्निकामासो व्यृण्विरे ।
paragraphs.translit: tava tye soma śaktibhirnikāmāso vyṛṇvire |

paragraphs.text: These sages, have thrown open-at your glad carouse-the stall of kine and horses. Thou art waxing great
paragraphs.original: गृत्सस्य धीरास्तवसो वि वो मदे व्रजं गोमन्तमश्विनं विवक्षसे
paragraphs.translit: gṛtsasya dhīrāstavaso vi vo made vrajaṃ gomantamaśvinaṃ vivakṣase

paragraphs.text: 6. Our herds thou guardest, Soma, and the moving world spread far and wide.
paragraphs.original: पशुं नः सोम रक्षसि पुरुत्रा विष्ठितं जगत् ।
paragraphs.translit: paśuṃ naḥ soma rakṣasi purutrā viṣṭhitaṃ jagat |

paragraphs.text: Thou fittest them for living,-at your glad carouse-looking upon all beings. Thou art waxing great.
paragraphs.original: समाकृणोषि जीवसे वि वो मदे विश्वा सम्पश्यन्भुवना विवक्षसे
paragraphs.translit: samākṛṇoṣi jīvase vi vo made viśvā sampaśyanbhuvanā vivakṣase

paragraphs.text: 7. On all sides, Soma, be to us a Guardian ne'er to be deceived.
paragraphs.original: त्वं नः सोम विश्वतो गोपा अदाभ्यो भव ।
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ naḥ soma viśvato gopā adābhyo bhava |

paragraphs.text: King, drive away our foemen-at your glad carouse:-let not the wicked rule us. Thou art waxing great.
paragraphs.original: सेध राजन्नप स्रिधो वि वो मदे मा नो दुःशंस ईशता विवक्षसे
paragraphs.translit: sedha rājannapa sridho vi vo made mā no duḥśaṃsa īśatā vivakṣase

paragraphs.text: 8. Be watchful, Soma, passing wise, to give us store of vital strength.
paragraphs.original: त्वं नः सोम सुक्रतुर्वयोधेयाय जागृहि ।
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ naḥ soma sukraturvayodheyāya jāgṛhi |

paragraphs.text: More skilled than man to guide us,-at your glad carouse-save us from harm and sorrow. Thou art waxing great.
paragraphs.original: क्षेत्रवित्तरो मनुषो वि वो मदे द्रुहो नः पाह्यंहसो विवक्षसे
paragraphs.translit: kṣetravittaro manuṣo vi vo made druho naḥ pāhyaṃhaso vivakṣase

paragraphs.text: 9. Chief slayer of our foemen, thou, Indu, art Indra's gracious Friend,
paragraphs.original: त्वं नो वृत्रहन्तमेन्द्रस्येन्दो शिवः सखा ।
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ no vṛtrahantamendrasyendo śivaḥ sakhā |

paragraphs.text: When warriors invoke him-at your glad carouse -in fight, to win them offspring. Thou art waxing great.
paragraphs.original: यत्सीं हवन्ते समिथे वि वो मदे युध्यमानास्तोकसातौ विवक्षसे
paragraphs.translit: yatsīṃ havante samithe vi vo made yudhyamānāstokasātau vivakṣase

paragraphs.text: 10. Victorious is this gladdening drink: to Indra dear it grows in strength.
paragraphs.original: अयं घ स तुरो मद इन्द्रस्य वर्धत प्रियः ।
paragraphs.translit: ayaṃ gha sa turo mada indrasya vardhata priyaḥ |

paragraphs.text: This-at your glad carouse -enhanced the mighty hymn of the great sage Kaksivan. Thou art waxing great.
paragraphs.original: अयं कक्षीवतो महो वि वो मदे मतिं विप्रस्य वर्धयद्विवक्षसे
paragraphs.translit: ayaṃ kakṣīvato maho vi vo made matiṃ viprasya vardhayadvivakṣase

paragraphs.text: 11. This to the sage who offers gifts brings power that comes from wealth in kine.
paragraphs.original: अयं विप्राय दाशुषे वाजाँ इयर्ति गोमतः ।
paragraphs.translit: ayaṃ viprāya dāśuṣe vājām̐ iyarti gomataḥ |

paragraphs.text: This, better than the seven, hath-at your glad carouse-furthered the blind, the cripple. Thou art waxing great.
paragraphs.original: अयं सप्तभ्य आ वरं वि वो मदे प्रान्धं श्रोणं च तारिषद्विवक्षसे
paragraphs.translit: ayaṃ saptabhya ā varaṃ vi vo made prāndhaṃ śroṇaṃ ca tāriṣadvivakṣase
